author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: bowl hull with a flat stern deck stepping up to a raised bow, a cabin with a funnel on its roof, and a smooth wave line below; reads as a ship at sea like the reference. The rejected drawing merged the hull into the waves.
omissions: The reference's second wave line is dropped: two waves plus hull, cabin and funnel cannot keep 8-unit clearances within 36 units of height. The cabin's slight taper is drawn upright.
drawing_plan: SQUARE; hull deck y 20 from x 6, 45-degree rise to bow y 16 at x 34..42, bezier sides to keel y 29; cabin x 10..24 to y 11 with funnel x 13..21 to y 6; wave half-periods of 9 between y 38 and 42.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'ship': hull outline with cabin on deck and a wave line under it.
